$comment: Feature parity matrix for the mobile release train. Process, statuses and gating rule: docs/mobile-release-train.md. Validate with `pnpm --filter @bike4mind/scripts mobile-release validate`.

features.title: Sign-in (OAuth 2.0 + PKCE web flow)
features.notes: Android release builds need the b4m-android-app OAuth client and assetlinks.json on the server.

features.title: Chat: send, stream and settle a reply over the realtime socket
Client version handshake and update-required screen
Account deletion and restore
features.notes: Required by both stores before public release.

features.title: Studio media gallery
features.notes: Android: green once the gallery items in apps/android/DEVICE_TESTING.md pass on a device.

features.title: Deep links and universal / app links
features.notes: Android: green once the link items in apps/android/DEVICE_TESTING.md pass on a device with assetlinks.json live.

features.title: Share sheet, camera and voice capture
Assistant brief, opened from the brief_ready push and in-app
features.notes: Android: green once the brief items in apps/android/DEVICE_TESTING.md pass on a device.

features.title: Live agent progress outside the app (Live Activities)
features.notes: Android: green once the agent-run items in apps/android/DEVICE_TESTING.md pass on a device, including an Android 16 Live Update.

features.title: Scan a bill and hand it to the assistant: confirm the extracted obligation, see it in a brief before it is due
features.notes: Both platforms: green once a scanned invoice is handed off, corrected, confirmed and filed on a physical device (the document scanner is unavailable on simulators and emulators).
